messages:
alex_writer: Drafted final blog copy and CTAs for Redwood Optimize. PTAL — aiming Wed 10:00am PT publish.

sara_marketing: drop the final hero line + UTM and I'll prep scheduling. main ask: make webinar CTA impossible to miss.

alex_writer: Final hero headline: 'Reduce Inference Cost by Up to 50% with Redwood Optimize'
Hero teaser: 'Lower per-token bills without giving up latency — learn how in our launch webinar.'
Primary CTA: Register -> https://redwood.com/events/optimize-launch?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=organic (please gate form)
Secondary CTA: Try -> https://console.redwood.com/optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=organic

mike_growth: UTM looks good. CMS form should set hidden lead_source=blog_launch_optimize and push to HubSpot list 'optimize_launch_registrants'. Will confirm once form is live.

ben_pm: need the caveat near the top: add 'in benchmarked workloads' and short note that results vary by model family and sequence length.

anne_legal: approve with qualifier. Please add footer text: 'Results from Redwood benchmark suite; your results may vary.' Also avoid unqualified superlatives elsewhere.

jess_design: Ill deliver hero PNG and alt text by EOD. Alt: 'Split-screen: cost chart (left) vs latency gauge (right), Redwood Optimize logo center.'

alex_writer: added qualifier in second paragraph and included link to internal eval doc. CMS draft saved: https://redwood.internal/cms/drafts/optimize-launch-1769998400

publish-bot: CMS draft 'optimize-launch-1769998400' scheduled for 1769998800 by alex_writer

sara_marketing: scheduling ok. jess drop the image and mike confirm HubSpot list hookup. once both green we publish and send reminder email 1 hour after.
